sn21.3:5.1: _Ghaṭā_ means either “pot” or “mass”. As a measure it is estimated variously at around 10 kg, 20 kg, or 200 kg. Given the context, I think it was a mound of salt such as would be seen at a salt mine.
sn21.3:6.1: This verse also found at [sn1.48:4.1](), [mn143:17.15](), and [thag20.1:43.1]().
